title: Lead Specialist - Industrial Engineering
description:
Autoliv's primary goal is to Save More Lives. Our products never get a second chance. This is why we can never compromise on quality. We are working to increase vehicle safety by developing seatbelts, airbags and steering wheels and you can be part of our team as
 **ROLE** 
 .
   

  

**Location:** 
 Badli, India
   

  

**Department:** 
 TND – Process Engineering Development (PED)
   

  

**Reporting To:** 
 PED Manager
   

  

**Experience:** 
 10\-14 Years
   

  

 Autoliv is looking for an experienced
 **Associate Manager \- Process Engineering Development (PED)** 
 to drive industrialization, process excellence, lean manufacturing, and continuous improvement initiatives. This role offers an opportunity to lead new product industrialization, process optimization, automation projects, and capability\-building initiatives within a dynamic automotive manufacturing environment.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Safety First (Non\-Negotiable)
   

  

* Champion a zero\-incident safety culture across all PED processes.
* Lead Process Risk Assessments, including PFMEA and MSRA, and drive corrective actions.
* Ensure compliance with ergonomics and workplace safety standards.
* Promote safe process design through mistake\-proofing, containment controls, and risk mitigation.


 New Product Industrialization (NPI)
   

  

* Lead industrialization activities from RFQ through SOP and ramp\-up.
* Design and implement robust manufacturing processes aligned with product requirements.
* Develop and maintain:
+ Process Flow Diagrams (PFD)
+ PFMEA
+ Work Instructions
+ Process Validation Plans

* Ensure on\-time launch with right\-first\-time manufacturing capability.


 Process Capability \& Quality Excellence
   

  

* Achieve and sustain process capability targets (Cp/Cpk) for critical characteristics.
* Implement SPC, Control Plans, and reaction plans.
* Drive variation reduction and process standardization initiatives.
* Deploy Poka\-Yoke solutions and automation to achieve a zero\-defect mindset.


 Continuous Improvement \& Operational Excellence
   

  

* Lead Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and APS deployment initiatives.
* Drive productivity, efficiency, and waste elimination across manufacturing processes.
* Conduct time and motion studies to improve operational effectiveness.
* Lead structured problem\-solving activities using 8D, 5 Why, and QC tools.
* Deliver measurable improvements in OEE, yield, quality, and cost.


 Equipment \& Technology Development
   

  

* Define manufacturing process and equipment specifications.
* Lead machine development, pre\-acceptance activities, commissioning, and validation.
* Drive automation and digitalization initiatives aligned with Industry 4\.0 standards.
* Ensure alignment between process capability and technological requirements.


 Cross\-Functional Collaboration
   

  

* Partner closely with:
+ R\&D for DFM/DFA and design reviews
+ Quality teams for APQP and PPAP activities
+ Operations \& Maintenance teams
+ EHS teams

* Ensure seamless alignment between product design, manufacturing processes, and plant capabilities.


 Standardization \& Knowledge Sharing
   

  

* Develop and implement best practices across manufacturing lines.
* Ensure compliance with IATF 16949 and Autoliv global standards.
* Share lessons learned and best practices within the global PED network.


 Team Development \& Leadership
   

  

* Build and develop a high\-performing Process Engineering team.
* Strengthen team capabilities in:
+ Safe Process Design
+ New Product Introduction (NPI)
+ Structured Problem Solving
+ Lean Manufacturing

* Foster a culture of ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement.


**Required Skills \& Competencies**
 Technical Expertise
   

  

* Process Design \& Industrialization
* PFMEA, Control Plans, SPC, and DOE
* Process Validation \& Capability Studies
* Lean Manufacturing \& Six Sigma
* Automation \& Industry 4\.0 Implementation
* Process Digitalization
* Manufacturing Excellence Tools


 Leadership \& Behavioral Competencies
   

  

* Strong business acumen and customer\-first mindset.
* Sense of urgency, ownership, and accountability.
* Data\-driven decision\-making capabilities.
* Excellent problem\-solving and execution skills.
* Ability to lead by example in Safety and Quality.
* Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience working in cross\-functional and global environments.


**Qualifications**
* BE/B.Tech in Mechanical, Electronics, or Electrical Engineering.
* Certifications in AutoCAD, PLM, and Six Sigma will be an added advantage.


**Experience**
* 10\-14 years of experience in Process Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or related functions within the automotive or manufacturing industry.
* Proven experience in New Product Industrialization, Lean Manufacturing, Process Capability Improvement, and Automation Projects.


**We will be more than glad to chat with you about your experience and your career goals.**
 In our international work setting, you will find a range of opportunities that are designed to enhance your career and personal development. Including new and different perspectives is part of what ensures the team’s success. We are committed to develop people’s skills, knowledge and creative potential. Our training and development programs emphasize technical competency, leadership development and business management skill.
   

  

**More lives saved – more life lived!**

title: Project Planner, Industrial Project, PEB
description:
**Job Title**
 Project Planner, Industrial Project, PEB
   

  

**Job Description Summary**
 This role is responsible for every aspect of the project, including leading a team capable of meeting or exceeding client expectations for their vision. Successful project managers assemble and manage these individuals to make a fine\-tuned project machine.
   

  

**Job Description**
**About the Role:**
* Leadership and course setting of the project; overall accountability of the project. Responsible for overall delivery of designated project within timelines, budget \& quality standards
* Assesses client requirement and strategizes the implementation of project design methods for constructability, quality, cost and time.
* Formulates and implements procurement strategy conducive to the business and project needs. Identifies procurement opportunities to optimize time, quality and cost.
* Formulation of execution strategy and control strategy with the cooperation of the client which includes but not limited to the procurement plan, contract management strategy, staffing plan of the Team.
* Lead project design review meetings to ensure meeting client’s objectives and overall alignment to business strategy.
* Manages multiple stakeholder scenarios including teams such as Client Teams, Design Teams, Quality Consultants, Audit Teams, CRM/Marketing Teams, Facility Management Teams, etc.
* Manages escalations and solutions at the highest levels of multiple stakeholders.
* Review of construction methods with reference to feasibility, scope for improvement, alternate cost and time effective methods to achieve the desired goals with optimum resources.
* Overall monitoring and controlling the project execution.
* Implementation of all Cushman \& Wakefield company policies at project site.
* Interfaces internally in Cushman \& Wakefield for all strategic matters
* Identify project risks and develop mitigation plans for the same. Discuss the same with stake holders and implement the mitigation actions after sign off.
* Ensure Project close out with all required documentation.
* Ensure transfer of lessons from project and implement the same from previous project.
* Ensure the contract between client and Cushman \& Wakefield is implemented.


**About You**
* B.E. Civil
* 20 Years \& above of relevant experience
* Should have completed at least 4\-5 Industrial / Industrial shed / PEB projects end to end during the tenure
* Candidate working with Project Management Consultancy would be preferred
* Technical awareness of civil, electro\-mechanical, and architectural works
* Excellent organizational and motivational skills
* Outstanding attention to detail and observation ability
* Exceptional communication and interpersonal abilities


**Why join Cushman \& Wakefield?**
 As one of the leading global real estate services firms transforming the way people work, shop and live working at Cushman \& Wakefield means you will benefit from;
   

  

* Being part of a growing global company;
* Career development and a promote from within culture;
* An organisation committed to Diversity and Inclusion


 We're committed to providing work\-life balance for our people in an inclusive, rewarding environment.
   

  

 We achieve this by providing a flexible and agile work environment by focusing on technology and autonomy to help our people achieve their career ambitions. We focus on career progression and foster a promotion from within culture, leveraging global opportunities to ensure we retain our top talent. We encourage continuous learning and development opportunities to develop personal, professional and technical capabilities, and we reward with a comprehensive employee benefits program.
   

  

**We have a vision of the future, where people simply belong.**
*That's why we support and celebrate inclusive causes, not just on days of recognition throughout the year, but every day. We embrace diversity across race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or persons with disabilities or protected veteran status.*
*We ensure DEI is part of our DNA as a global community \- it means we go way beyond than just talking about it \- we live it. If you want to live it too, join us.*
 INCO: “Cushman \& Wakefield”
